name: notificationscontacts
description: AWS User Notifications Contacts is a service that allows you to create and manage email contacts for AWS User Notifications.

subcommands.name: activate-email-contact
subcommands.description: Activates an email contact using an activation code.

subcommands.name: create-email-contact
subcommands.description: Creates an email contact for the provided email address.

subcommands.name: list-email-contacts
subcommands.description: Lists all email contacts created under the Account.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Lists all of the tags associated with the Amazon Resource Name (ARN) that you specify.

subcommands.name: send-activation-code
subcommands.description: Sends an activation email to the email address associated with the specified email contact.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Attaches a key-value pair to a resource, as identified by its Amazon Resource Name (ARN).

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Detaches a key-value pair from a resource, as identified by its Amazon Resource Name (ARN).
